thread:
Sam H: Heads up — we discovered a replication bug affecting onboarding for 8 tenants in the EU region. Some customers see incomplete embeddings and authorization errors during SSO. I'm drafting customer comms.
Priya N: Which accounts? do we have a list and severity/SLAs impacted?
Sam H: Affected: AcclaimCorp, BrightList, NovaSearch, DataWeave, KindredAI, EconoDocs, Fetchly, LumenBox. Severity: partial degraded function; some failure to complete first-time ingest.
Liam K: We're seeing 401/502 during batch reindex jobs. Eng is looking. ETA for a root cause? customers already pinging CSMs.
Chen Z: Root cause likely race in token refresh + cache eviction in private onboarding flow. I've got a hotfix branch, running tests now. If green, can ship canary in 30–45m.
Sam H: Ok canary = good. Priority: communicate status to customers with mitigation steps and offer enablement session + one month credit if migration delayed. Draft below — please suggest edits.
Sam H: ```Hi <customer>,
We’re reaching out because you may have experienced failures during onboarding earlier today (SSO token exchanges and initial embeddings). Engineering has identified the issue and is deploying a fix. Next steps:
• What to expect: canary deploy within 1h, full rollback if needed.
• Mitigation: retry pipeline (detailed command attached) or we can re-run ingest on our side.
• Compensation: one month of account credit for impacted accounts + priority enablement session.
We’ll follow up with an RCA within 72 hours. Reply to this thread to schedule your session.
— Sam, Customer Success
```
Priya N: Text looks good. For legal/Sales: remove 'platform credit' phrasing? Suggest 'account credit'. Also add clear SLA expectation and link to status page.
Liam K: From eng side, add note: 'no data loss expected' and 'ingest resumes automatically after retry'.
Sam H: Updated draft and the list of next actions: 1) Chen to push canary 2) Liam to confirm whether re-ingest API can be exposed to CS 3) Priya to pre-approve credit language with RevOps 4) Sam to send comms to eight accounts and open calendar for enablement. Target send = in 45m.
Chen Z: Canary pushed to EU canary pool at 2168887890. Initial metric: error rate down 80%. Rolling to full in 20m pending green.
IncidentBot: Deployment 2168887890 by chen_z completed to canary. Monitoring alerts baseline.
Sam H: Thanks team. I'll queue customer messages and post templates here so CS reps can personalize. Also: capture feedback via short survey link after session. Anyone want to own postmortem draft for RCA? Priya?
Priya N: I can take RCA draft, will collaborate with Chen and Liam. Ping me when full rollout completes.
Sam H: Perfect — will send comms now and add a follow-up thread for RCA. :thumbsup:
